title: Google Free API in Advanced Paste

judgment.rationale: A maintainer already explained that the reported “free API” path is not a supported Google AI Studio configuration for Advanced Paste and asked the reporter to try a supported paid key/model combination first.
evidence: The issue reports “An error occurred during the paste operation” while trying to use a free Google AI Studio API path and guessing model names.
The only maintainer reply explains that the supported Google AI Studio options are paid and that retired model names such as gemini-1.5-pro may no longer be valid.
That maintainer reply ends with /needinfo, and the issue still carries the Needs-Author-Feedback label with no reporter follow-up.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep the issue in waiting-on-author state until the reporter confirms whether the failure persists with a supported key and a currently listed model name.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current evidence does not yet establish a PowerToys code defect; it first needs confirmation against a supported Google AI Studio configuration.

issue_context.summary: The reporter saw an Advanced Paste failure while trying an unsupported or uncertain Google AI Studio setup, and the maintainer response redirected them to supported paid-key/model combinations that the reporter has not yet confirmed.
known_information: The issue is filed against PowerToys 0.100.2 with screenshots of the Advanced Paste configuration and the error message.
The body says the reporter was trying a “free API” path and experimenting with model names.
A maintainer explained that the supported Google AI Studio paths are paid and named current model families to try instead.
The issue is still labeled Needs-Author-Feedback and has no reporter reply after that guidance.
inferences: The current public evidence points more strongly to unsupported or stale provider configuration than to a confirmed Advanced Paste code regression.
A code fix is premature until the reporter confirms whether the same error persists on a supported model/key combination.
issue_context.analysis: This should stay in waiting-on-author rather than shifting to actionable bug design. The key open question is not “what code should change,” but whether the failure remains after using a supported Google AI Studio model and authentication path. The current maintainer comment already asks for that discriminating evidence.
initial_investigation: The live issue discussion contains a maintainer explanation of the supported Google AI Studio authentication and model-name expectations, ending in /needinfo.
No newer upstream comment, linked fix, or duplicate evidence changes that waiting-on-author state.

information_gaps.information: Whether the paste failure still occurs when using a supported paid Google AI Studio key/subscription and a model name currently listed in Google AI Studio.
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether the issue is a PowerToys defect or an unsupported configuration/reporting problem.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retry the same paste flow with a supported Google AI Studio key and a model copied from the current Google AI Studio model list, then reply with whether the error still appears.

author_wait_evidence.requested_evidence: Confirm whether the paste failure still happens when using a supported paid Google AI Studio configuration and one of the currently listed model IDs.
